Usage: astryx template [options] [name] [path]

List, show, or scaffold page and block templates

Arguments:
  name             Template id (see --list). Omit it to list the templates.
  path             Where to scaffold the template, relative to the project root. A path that ends in .tsx, .ts, .jsx, .js, .mjs, .cjs, .css, .scss, .json, .md or .html is the file to write; any other path is a directory, which receives page.tsx for a page template or the block's own file name for a block. Omit it to print the source.

Options:
  --list           List available templates (narrow with --type and --package) and do nothing else: <name>, <path>, --skeleton and --overwrite are refused
  --type <type>    Filter by template type: page or block
  --package <pkg>  Narrow to templates from a specific package. Use @astryxdesign/core to select an original hidden by an integration replacement.
  --skeleton       Show layout skeleton with spatial annotations (padding, gap, nesting) instead of the source. Needs <name>. It writes nothing, so <path> and --overwrite are refused with ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT
  --cdn [path]     Write the no-build-step CDN starter page and do nothing else: <name>, --list, --skeleton, --type and --package are refused. The page goes to the --cdn value, else to <path>, else cdn.template.html, and that path is always the file itself. A value right after --cdn (anything not starting with -) is taken as that path
  -f, --overwrite  Replace an existing target file. Without it an existing file is refused (ERR_FILE_EXISTS) and an existing CDN page is left as is
  -h, --help       display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success, including a CDN page left untouched because it already exists
  1  unknown or ambiguous template, no source, a path escape, an existing target without --overwrite, or --list with a type outside page or block or a package that provides no templates

Examples:
  # List templates
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --json
  # List exact Core ids
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 --json template --list --package @astryxdesign/core
  # Scaffold into the app
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template dashboard ./src/app
  # Select a replaced Core original
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-side-nav ./src/app --package @astryxdesign/core
  # CDN starter page
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --cdn
  # CDN starter page, elsewhere
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --cdn public/demo.html

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/template
